full_page.content:
1936, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 91 Cont.
Feb. Mrs. (Rip) Van Winkel. ... . cast
Page 92
Feb. Josephine Macklow - 49 - trained nurse out of position - a widow many yrs. has one daughter, would like to educate and keep in good company herself. Goes to confession To-day Ist in yrs.
Feb. 15 Margaret Machine - 18 - near Dearborn - blind till last Xmas - from August when Enrolled Xmas eve. since then has decidedly improved .. .....
16 Harry Czarmak - 15 - very serious heart condition, to come home in ambulance as hopeless case next Tuesday.
17 Laurena Pringle - 26 - keeping company with an atheist same age. The atheist is known to have gotten at least one other in very grave trouble. Yet plans go on for the marriage ...... promises of other!
Esther Murphy of Green Bay, Wis. - 50 - Jan. Ist - Extremely nerveous Sister leaving To-night ...
Tridnum
Page 93 Feb. 19 Mrs. Fr. Radzialowck - 54 - down with T.B. since last June; has large family - two daughters nuns (Felicians)
Margaret Mrs. Wieske - 38 - gave birth to her fifth baby last Dec. 29th - now anxious about lump and pain in breast about the heart. Theo Ruczko - 23 - epileptic spells often - 3 a day .....
Sam Lambros in Eloise - 50 -"Orthodox" (husband) tuomer on brain 6 yrs .... bad now - almost blind yr & 2
Mrs. Ann Soderland - 54 - brain tuomer - had operation Dec. 12th last - now paralyzed on one side .... 14 doctors (in Harper) present at operation - 3 hours (Her husband a convert) was enrolled in Ser. Mass As'n while she was on "table". All say it was miraculous that she lived .... Prayers are asked for .....
Mrs. Mary C. Sage - 65 - Neuritis almost like paralysis
Page 94 Blank Page
